phase1_candidates.hypothesis: Index receiver method headers once per captured related-source file instead of recompiling and rematching one regex per type/method/file tuple.
phase1_candidates.profile: p0-bundle.cpu + p0-bundle.mem; goMethodWants cumulative allocation dominates
phase1_candidates.compatibility: Preserve suffix-based receiver matching, exported method filtering, snippet extraction, uses counts, and sorted attachment order; all five ordered-plan SHA256 values must match baseline.
phase1_candidates.comparison: 20 iterations per frozen workload with the same benchmark binary flags; report isolated preparation separately from end-to-end latency.
phase1_candidates.stop: Any changed ordered payload or memory/cost/coverage regression blocks promotion.

phase1_candidates.hypothesis: Reuse captured repository file bytes, line splits, and identical grep results within a lookup session; join at most four lookups from one returned tool turn in original call order.
phase1_candidates.preregistered_scope: performance-follow-on-plan.md Phase 1 item 2 (predates code); local fixtures only, no quality or end-to-end speed claim
phase1_candidates.comparison: 20 iterations, same binaries and flags, local tracked 4096-line file read in 12 windows and eight identical git searches; baseline restores original repotools.go and uses a sequential lookup turn
phase1_candidates.guards: Live waiter retries a separately cancelled loader; cancelled/transient reads and grep errors are not retained; stable absence is retained; each pinned review head resets sharing; lookup limit and submission bound starts; all workers join before answers append; charged retained payloads/line indexes capped at 8 MiB; oversized source remains readable to Jev without retention.
phase1_candidates.stop: Any changed tool answer, failed race guard, or worse measured memory blocks promotion.
phase1_candidates.scope_limit: Provider file reads remain per captured lookup session; this does not make a mutable local worktree an immutable Git snapshot. No model or embedding responses use internal/memo.

phase1_candidates.hypothesis: Parallel built-in Detect checks shorten detection on frozen local snapshots. Detect does not run analyzers or source code.
phase1_candidates.comparison: Same default built-in runner roster and frozen source snapshots; sequential vs goroutine-per-runner; 20 samples, GOMAXPROCS=4; compare ordered detection name/error hashes and wall time.
phase1_candidates.stop: Do not change production if representative cases show no gain; no model or full-review latency claim. Module analyzer execution and golangci locking unchanged.
phase1_candidates.outcome: Rejected: mixed sub-millisecond gains, 54% median regression on the large frozen change. Keep production detection serial.

phase1_candidates.hypothesis: A per-review provider source memo avoids duplicate reads between flow capture, bundle context and budget reassembly.
phase1_candidates.comparison: Five frozen workloads, default and $0.03 modeled budget, three profiling iterations; original versus memoized provider; scripted empty model responses, no network or source execution; hash ordered model messages and prepared plan.
phase1_candidates.stop: Any changed model input, budget decision, coverage or source error prevents production promotion. This measures a scripted pipeline, not real model latency or quality.
phase1_candidates.network_control: Repeat the same scripted profile with a fixed 2ms delay per provider FileContent/ListDir dispatch, three iterations. This is simulated IO and never contacts a provider; compare identical plan/request/budget hashes.
phase1_candidates.outcome: Not promoted:3-repeat local and2ms simulated-IO profiles preserve plans and requests but show mixed latency and local regressions. Production source reads unchanged.

phase1_candidates.hypothesis: Byte-offset source selection avoids splitting whole files for every design-context span and avoids a second whole-file split when rendering the same spans.
phase1_candidates.profile_evidence: engineering-before CPU:SelectSourceSpans33.73s cumulative,24.61s in strings.SplitAfter; baseline engineering40-file prep13.53s,13.03GB allocations/op.
phase1_candidates.comparison: Existing engineering baseline binary/three-sample frozen plans, candidate same settings; exact design execution/ordered plan hashes and output-equivalence fuzz oracle.
phase1_candidates.stop: Any changed selected bytes, invalid-span error, original line numbering, task ID, omission, budget or packed plan blocks promotion; no model calls or quality claim.
